## Checklist

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/pikabrofar/sentidoS/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) under the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/).
- [ ] `make test` passes in every package I touched.
- [ ] If this changes what data is collected, stored, retained or sent, I updated [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/pikabrofar/sentidoS/blob/main/PRIVACY.md).
- [ ] No new network calls, or each new one is documented in [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/pikabrofar/sentidoS/blob/main/PRIVACY.md).
- [ ] New dependencies, if any, have a compatible license and are listed in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- [ ] This doesn't add features designed for covert recording or tracking of other people.
